contract.title: Adversarial review of global pressure bracket R01
contract.goal: Review exact commit fcfc1e42a7780a36ab8452c1659211f3d4c19da8. Try to break the authorization and scientific-claim gates: check scene-check contract and coverage hashes, matrix artifact path normalization, regenerated package identity, population-gravity endpoint semantics, runbook/finalization boundaries, and whether any access/route/downlink failure could be mislabeled as ISL pressure. Check the package has no hidden bypass or stale artifact. Identify blockers versus minors. Produce a candidate review receipt with exact paths/fields and explicit unknowns; do not claim any VM result.
acceptance: Return a clear PASS, REQUEST_CHANGES, or BLOCKED verdict.
Candidate receipt must use agent-review-receipt/v2, role adversarial, exact work_id/revision, distinct reviewer identity, evidence, blocking_findings, unknowns, and required_revision.
Every finding cites an exact repository path and line or JSON field and distinguishes blocker from minor.
Explicitly state whether the package is safe to proceed to finalization/authorization and that no Pro-tier routing was used.
requiredEvidence: Exact file paths and line or JSON-field references
Observed matrix, scene-check contract, coverage, and authorization-chain facts
Candidate receipt JSON and a check that no Pro-tier routing was used
